description.subtitle: AC Milan 2025 2026 brief training puma t-shirt - black
description.tagline: El primer paso hacia la gloria rossonera
description.intro: For future Rossoneri champions this children's training shirt offers the ideal comfort and club pride that inspires the younger ones to give their best in each play.
key_benefits: Youth and official design: adapted to the child body with the same look as professionals.
Comfort assured: Light fabric that allows training, running or playing without discomfort.
Effective Breathing: Anti-sweat technology to maintain freshness.
Rossonero style from a young age: Motivate and connect with AC Milan values.
